note: The AAN guideline's Level B names MIG-99, a specific CO2 extract, not feverfew generally; the Cochrane review of generic feverfew (5 trials, 343 patients) reports mixed results. The other two selected trials are combination designs (acupuncture arm; sublingual feverfew+ginger). Catalog rows are mostly unspecified feverfew, and the potency axis is parthenolide, not extract mg. Same material-scope shape as Permixon.
